item.title: MaiaSpace Ships Maia Mechanical Models to Launch Site
item.dc:creator: Andrew Parsonson
item.description:
ArianeGroup subsidiary MaiaSpace has shipped full-scale mechanical models of the first and second stages of its Maia rocket to French Guiana. The stages will be used for a series of combined tests at the Guiana Space Centre in the first half of 2027. MaiaSpace announced on 25 November that the two stages left the company’s […]

item.title: Arianespace Completes 10th Ariane 6 Flight With Next Expected on 17 December
item.dc:creator: Andrew Parsonson
item.description:
Arianespace has successfully completed the tenth flight of its Ariane 6 rocket, deploying another 36 Amazon Leo satellites into orbit. The rocket’s sixth and likely final flight of 2026 is currently expected to take place on 17 December. The Ariane 6 rocket lifted off from the Guiana Space Centre at 11:14 UTC on 24 November. […]

item.title: BepiColombo Enters Orbit Around Mercury Despite “Software Glitch”
item.dc:creator: Andrew Parsonson
item.description: The European Space Agency’s BepiColombo mission has successfully entered orbit around Mercury despite a software glitch that resulted in a shorter-than-planned thruster burn. item.title: Eutelsat Wins $60 Million US Space Force Contract
item.dc:creator: Andrew Parsonson
item.description:
The US arm of European satellite operator Eutelsat has secured a two-year contract worth more than $60 million to provide satellite communications services to the US armed forces.
